header.title: How to Replace a Washing Machine Timer
header.description: This guide provides step-by-step instructions on how to replace a washing machine timer. Follow these instructions to safely remove the old timer and install a new one.

steps.description: The first step is to disconnect the power supply to the washing machine to prevent electric shock.
actions: turn off the power
unplug it from the socket
turn off the circuit in your breaker box

steps.description: Protect the machine's finish by covering the top with a cloth or plastic sheet.
actions: cover the top
use a thick cloth
use a plastic sheet

steps.description: Remove the timer knob by pulling it off the shaft without using tools.
actions: Take off the timer knob
Pull it off of the shaft

steps.description: Remove the control panel cover to access the washer's timer.
actions: Loosen and remove the screws attaching the front to the back panel.
Pull the cover out of place.
Rotate the cover forward.

steps.description: This step involves removing the existing timer from the control panel by removing screws, disconnecting the wiring harness, and releasing the mounting tab.
actions: Locate the timer
Remove screws holding the timer in place
Set screws aside in a safe place
Disconnect the wiring harness by pressing the tab
Pull out the wiring harness
Press the mounting tab below the timer
Take the timer out of the control panel

steps.description: Replace the old washing machine timer with a compatible new one, ensuring it's properly mounted.
actions: purchase a replacement timer compatible with your washing machine model
consult your manufacturer if unsure about timer compatibility
replace the old timer with the new timer
place the new timer in its spot
snap the mounting tab back into position

steps.description: Reconnect the wiring harness to the new timer, secure it, and fasten the mounting screws.
actions: Reconnect the harness to the new timer
Snap the harness back into its original position
Screw in the mounting screws

steps.description: Reassemble the washer, restore power, and test the replacement timer.
actions: Reattach the face of the control panel
Reattach the knob
Plug the washer back in
Turn the breaker back on
Test the machine
